create_your_account_description: Join us today and experience the convenience of effortless parking at your fingertips. Sign up now to unlock a world of hassle-free parking solutions tailored just for you.
welcome_to_parking_app_description: Your ultimate parking solution. Discover, book, and manage parking spots effortlessly with our user-friendly app.
find_parking_spot_around_you_easily: Find parking spot around you easily
find_parking_spot_around_you_easily_desc: Locate nearby spots in seconds with real-time availability, prices, and directions. Filter by distance, price, type, or EV charging, and navigate straight to your space — no more circling the streets.
book_and_pay_parking_quickly_and_easily: Book and pay parking quickly and shortly
book_and_pay_parking_quickly_and_easily_: Skip the hassle of searching and queuing — find available parking spots near you, reserve them in advance, and pay securely in just a few taps. Enjoy a fast, seamless parking experience every time.
extend_parking_time_as_needed: Expand parking time as you need
extend_parking_time_as_needed_descriptio: Running late or deciding to stay longer ? Easily extend your parking session right from your phone. No need to rush back to the meter — just add more time in seconds and keep your spot stress-free.
find_the_best_parking_spot: Find the best car parking spot
find_the_best_parking_spot_description: Discover the best parking options tailored to your needs. Whether you prefer convenience, cost-effectiveness, or proximity, our app helps you find the perfect spot every time.
check_email_verify_account: Check your inbox to activate your account.
error_update_profile: An error occurred during profile update
password_min_length: Password must be at least 6 characters
push_notification_permission_not_granted: Permission not granted to get push token for push notification
privacy_policy_description: Learn how SmartParking handles and protects your information.
privacy_information_description: We collect the account, vehicle, reservation, payment, and location information needed to provide parking services and improve your experience.
privacy_usage_description: Your information is used to manage your account, process reservations and payments, provide support, and keep the app reliable and secure.
privacy_sharing_description: We only share the details required to complete your parking service, such as reservation details with the relevant parking operator or payment provider.
privacy_security_description: We use appropriate safeguards to protect your information. Keep your account credentials private and contact us if you notice unauthorized activity.
terms_description: These terms explain how you can use SmartParking and its parking services.
terms_use_description: Use the app lawfully and provide accurate account, vehicle, and booking information. You are responsible for activity carried out through your account.
terms_reservations_description: A reservation is subject to the availability and rules of the selected parking lot. Review your booking details and arrive within the reserved time.
terms_payments_description: Payment is required when completing an applicable booking. Charges, payment status, and any available cancellation options are shown in your reservation details.
terms_responsibilities_description: Follow parking-lot rules, respect other users and property, and ensure that your vehicle is suitable for the selected parking space.
help_center_description: Find quick answers to common questions about parking with SmartParking.
help_find_parking_question: How do I find a parking spot?
help_find_parking_answer: Use Find Parking to browse nearby lots, compare availability and prices, then choose the spot that works best for you.
help_make_reservation_question: How do I make a reservation?
help_make_reservation_answer: Select a parking lot, choose your vehicle and arrival details, then confirm your reservation from the booking screen.
help_payment_answer: Payments are completed securely during checkout. Your reservation payment status is available in your booking details.
help_cancel_reservation_answer: You can cancel an eligible pending reservation from its booking details before the parking session ends.
help_contact_support_description: Use the in-app Support chat to get help from our parking assistant.
about_app_description: SmartParking helps drivers find, reserve, pay for, and manage parking spaces with confidence.
about_feature_find: Find nearby parking with real-time availability.
about_feature_reserve: Reserve a spot before you arrive.
about_feature_pay: Pay securely and track your payment status.
about_feature_manage: Manage bookings, vehicles, and parking sessions in one place.
